candidates.label: Ureteroileal fistula with active hemorrhage from right renal artery pseudoaneurysm
Recurrent rectal cancer with invasion into right ureter and ileum causing ureteroileal fistula and renal artery erosion
Iatrogenic ureteroileal fistula and renal artery injury secondary to JJ stent placement or pelvic abscess drainage
Radiation-induced ureteroileal fistula and vascular injury
Persistent hemorrhage from right renal artery collateral vessels after embolisation

response.rationale: The record directly confirms a ureteroileal fistula and active hemorrhage from the right renal pelvis, with arterial bleeding. The most likely complete diagnosis is a ureteroileal fistula with associated renal artery pseudoaneurysm rupture. Recurrent rectal cancer is a plausible underlying cause but not confirmed. Other iatrogenic or radiation causes are less supported by the record.
